DELETE /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}.note: Permanent deletion has a typed sync/async method and is excluded from toolkit defaults.

DELETE /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}/que.note: Question removal has typed sync/async methods and is not replayed automatically.

GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}.note: Job status is exposed with sync and async clients and tested response identity.

GET /v1/scoring_models.note: Current model listing and response shape have typed sync/async client methods.

GET /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}.note: Current model details and question weights have typed sync/async methods with identity checks.

PATCH /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}.note: Rename, criteria, archive, and unarchive operations have typed sync/async methods.

POST /v1/ask.note: The classifier calls the current endpoint; decide remains a compatibility alias.

POST /v1/calibrate.note: Labeled data, row limits, add/remove question controls, and asynchronous responses are typed.

POST /v1/score.note: Record scoring supports schema flags and optional question-level probabilities and weights.

POST /v1/scoring_models.note: Typed model creation supports immediate criteria-only and asynchronous labeled-data modes.

POST /v1/scoring_models/{model_id}/quest.note: Question creation is typed and validates count and text limits; response includes usage status.
